subtitle_zh: 今天是我们乘坐“探索公主号”从温哥华前往安克雷奇航程的第五天。
subtitle_en: Today is day five of our Discovery Princess cruise from Vancouver to Anchorage.
notes: misc insertion 001; single location; segment 1/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 邮轮抵达史凯威后，我们上午游览了这座小镇历史悠久的市中心。
subtitle_en: After arriving in Skagway, we explored the town's historic downtown that morning.
notes: misc insertion 001; single location; segment 2/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 现在，我们今天第二次乘坐接驳船上岸，准备搭乘白隘口观光火车。
subtitle_en: Now we are taking the shuttle ashore again to board the White Pass scenic train.
notes: misc insertion 001; single location; segment 3/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 史凯威虽然人口不足一千，但港口依然挤满了来自各艘邮轮的游客。
subtitle_en: Although Skagway has under 1,000 residents, its port is packed with cruise passengers.
notes: misc insertion 001; single location; segment 4/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 火车不设指定座位，乘客可以任选空位就座。
subtitle_en: The train has no assigned seats, so passengers can choose any open seat.
notes: misc insertion 002; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 盘旋在空中的直升机，很可能正载着游客前往附近的冰川和其他景点。
subtitle_en: The helicopter overhead likely carries visitors to nearby glaciers and other sights.
notes: misc insertion 003; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 列车员检查了车票，乘务员随后讲解了安全规定。
subtitle_en: The conductor checked our tickets, and the attendant explained the safety rules.
notes: misc insertion 004; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 随着火车缓缓驶出史凯威，白隘口铁路之旅正式开始。
subtitle_en: As the train slowly leaves Skagway, the White Pass railway journey begins.
notes: misc insertion 005; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 这条铁路全长一百一十英里，修建于 1898 年的克朗代克淘金热时期。
subtitle_en: This 110-mile railway was built during the 1898 Klondike Gold Rush.
notes: misc insertion 006; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 当年，成千上万的淘金者正是从这里踏上前往加拿大育空地区的寻金之路。
subtitle_en: Back then, thousands of prospectors started here for Canada's Yukon goldfields.
notes: misc insertion 007; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 短短二十多英里，我们就将从海平面一路攀升到接近三千英尺的白隘口。
subtitle_en: In just over twenty miles, we will climb from sea level to nearly 3,000 feet.
notes: misc insertion 008; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 乘客们开始走到车厢连接处的露天平台。
subtitle_en: Passengers begin stepping onto the open platforms between the cars.
notes: misc insertion 009; single location; segment 1/2; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 在那里可以欣赏更好的景色，获得更身临其境的体验。
subtitle_en: They can enjoy better views and a more immersive experience.
notes: misc insertion 009; single location; segment 2/2; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 特别提醒：如果打算长时间待在露天平台，一定要穿上保暖衣物。
subtitle_en: A reminder: if you stay on the open platform, wear warm clothing.
notes: misc insertion 010; single location; segment 1/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 上午游览完市中心后，我把厚外套留在了船舱里。
subtitle_en: After the morning downtown tour, I left my heavy coat in the cabin.
notes: misc insertion 010; single location; segment 2/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 因为没想到会在火车旅途中在户外待上几个小时，后来十分后悔。
subtitle_en: I did not expect to spend hours outside on the train, and regretted it later.
notes: misc insertion 010; single location; segment 3/3; absolute video-relative timing.
